meta.extraction: values transcribed from paper tables, LLM-assisted, single pass, checked by automated consistency gates; not independently double-extracted

columns.R_layer: standard R layer the row maps to (log-nearest); null = none
columns.baseline: canonical baseline the gain is taken against
columns.canonical: cross-paper model identity, key into models; null when the model is specific to this paper
columns.cell: same-protocol cell id: rows sharing it were run side by side in one paper (same dataset, split, contrast, R, mask, experiment arm) and may be subtracted
columns.excluded_at: first filter that removed the row (null when in_main)
columns.family: coarse architecture family used in the analysis
columns.gain: value minus the baseline's value in the same cell
columns.model: model name as written in the paper
columns.out_of_range: gain outside the protocol's sanity range; check by hand
columns.paper: paper id (doi:... or arxiv:...); key into papers
columns.source: table or figure the value was read from, e.g. 'Table 2'; null when the extraction note gives no parseable reference

meta.encoding: rows/gains: a column listed in `values` holds an index into values[column]; other columns are raw
